scripts.preinstall:
node -e "if(process.env.npm_execpath && process.env.npm_execpath.includes('pnpm')) { throw new Error('
❌ ERROR: pnpm is not allowed. Please use bun instead.

To install dependencies, use:
  bun install
'); }"
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=ci_local TZ=jst HTML_FETCH_DELAY_MS=0 bun test --coverage --path-ignore-patterns '**/test/integration/system/**'; code=$?; bun scripts/filter-coverage-report.ts; exit $code
scripts.test:unit: NODE_ENV=ci_local TZ=jst HTML_FETCH_DELAY_MS=0 bun test packages/*/test/unittest
scripts.test:component: NODE_ENV=ci_local TZ=jst HTML_FETCH_DELAY_MS=0 USE_IN_MEMORY_DB=true bun test packages/*/test/integration/component
scripts.test:sit: NODE_ENV=ci_local TZ=jst HTML_FETCH_DELAY_MS=0 bun test packages/*/test/integration/system
scripts.test:all: bun run test:unit && bun run test:component && bun run test:sit
scripts.test:report: bun scripts/generate-test-report.ts run --layers=ut,component && bun scripts/generate-test-report.ts build
scripts.test:report:full: bun scripts/generate-test-report.ts run --layers=ut,component,sit,uat,front && bun scripts/generate-test-report.ts build
scripts.allure:build-results: mkdir -p test-report/allure-results && for f in ut component sit uat; do bun scripts/build-allure-results.ts $f test-report/raw/$f.xml test-report/allure-results --events=test-report/raw/$f.events.jsonl; done && cp scripts/allure-static/categories.json test-report/allure-results/categories.json
scripts.allure:generate: bun run allure:build-results && bun scripts/build-allure-executor.ts && bun scripts/build-allure-environment.ts && bunx allure-commandline generate test-report/allure-results --clean -o test-report/allure
scripts.format: biome format --write packages scripts tests eslint-rules docs *.json *.mjs *.md
scripts.format:check: biome format packages scripts tests eslint-rules docs *.json *.mjs *.md
scripts.lint: biome check packages scripts tests eslint-rules docs *.json *.mjs *.md && bunx eslint packages --ext .ts,.tsx
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write packages scripts tests eslint-rules docs *.json *.mjs *.md && bunx eslint --fix packages --ext .ts,.tsx
scripts.lint:check: biome check packages scripts tests eslint-rules docs *.json *.mjs *.md && bunx eslint --quiet --cache --cache-location .eslintcache --cache-strategy content packages --ext .ts,.tsx
scripts.pre-commit: bun run type-check && bun run lint:check
scripts.verify: bun run type-check && bun run lint:check && for pkg in core admin api batch; do (cd packages/$pkg && CI=true bun run test) || exit 1; done && bun run test:component
scripts.clean:branches: git fetch -p && git branch -vv | grep ': gone]' | awk '{print $1}' | xargs git branch -D
scripts.front:widgetbook: cd packages/front && flutter run -t lib/widgetbook.dart -d chrome --web-port 8081 --web-browser-flag "--disable-web-security" --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://race-schedule-test.tn-product.workers.dev
scripts.front:mock: cd packages/front && flutter run -t lib/main_mock.dart -d chrome --web-port 8082
